require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'redis'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'connection_pool'

# Mobile backend API with feature flags for gradual rollout
# Handles in-app purchase verification and reward distribution

REDIS_POOL = ConnectionPool.new(size: 10) { Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379') }

module FeatureFlags
  ROLLOUT_PERCENTAGES = {
    'double_rewards' => 25,
    'premium_loot_box' => 10,
    'bonus_currency' => 50
  }.freeze

  def self.enabled_for?(feature, user_id)
    REDIS_POOL.with do |redis|
      override = redis.hget("feature_overrides", "#{feature}:#{user_id}")
      return override == 'true' if override

      percentage = ROLLOUT_PERCENTAGES.fetch(feature, 0)
      user_bucket = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{feature}:#{user_id}")[0..7].to_i(16) % 100
      user_bucket < percentage
    end
  end
end

module RewardEngine
  BASE_REWARD = 100
  DOUBLE_MULTIPLIER = 2

  def self.calculate_reward(user_id, transaction_id)
    multiplier = 1
    multiplier = DOUBLE_MULTIPLIER if FeatureFlags.enabled_for?('double_rewards', user_id)
    BASE_REWARD * multiplier
  end

  def self.distribute_reward(user_id, transaction_id, amount)
    REDIS_POOL.with do |redis|
      distribution_key = "reward:#{transaction_id}"
      # Atomically check-and-set to prevent race conditions
      # SETNX returns true only if key didn't exist
      acquired = redis.setnx(distribution_key, amount)
      unless acquired
        existing = redis.get(distribution_key)
        return { already_distributed: true, amount: existing.to_i }
      end
      redis.expire(distribution_key, 86400 * 30) # 30 day TTL
      # Credit user balance
      redis.incrby("balance:#{user_id}", amount)
      { distributed: true, amount: amount }
    end
  end
end

module PurchaseVerifier
  def self.verify_receipt(receipt_data)
    # Simulated receipt verification against app store
    return nil unless receipt_data && receipt_data.length > 10
    {
      valid: true,
      transaction_id: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(receipt_data)[0..15],
      product_id: 'com.game.coins_pack',
      purchase_time: Time.now.to_i
    }
  end
end

before do
  content_type :json
  @request_id = SecureRandom.uuid
end

helpers do
  def authenticate!
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub(/^Bearer /, '')
    halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless token

    REDIS_POOL.with do |redis|
      user_id = redis.get("session:#{Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(token)}")
      halt 401, { error: 'invalid_token' }.to_json unless user_id
      @current_user_id = user_id
    end
  end

  def json_body
    @json_body ||= JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    halt 400, { error: 'invalid_json' }.to_json
  end
end

# Endpoint: Verify purchase and distribute rewards
post '/api/v1/purchases/verify' do
  authenticate!

  receipt = json_body[:receipt_data]
  halt 400, { error: 'missing_receipt' }.to_json unless receipt

  verification = PurchaseVerifier.verify_receipt(receipt)
  halt 422, { error: 'invalid_receipt' }.to_json unless verification && verification[:valid]

  transaction_id = verification[:transaction_id]

  # Calculate reward amount based on current feature flag state
  reward_amount = RewardEngine.calculate_reward(@current_user_id, transaction_id)

  # Distribute the calculated reward
  result = RewardEngine.distribute_reward(@current_user_id, transaction_id, reward_amount)

  status 200
  {
    request_id: @request_id,
    transaction_id: transaction_id,
    reward: result
  }.to_json
end

# Endpoint: Check feature flag status (used by mobile client for UI)
get '/api/v1/features/:feature_name' do
  authenticate!

  feature = params[:feature_name]
  halt 404, { error: 'unknown_feature' }.to_json unless FeatureFlags::ROLLOUT_PERCENTAGES.key?(feature)

  enabled = FeatureFlags.enabled_for?(feature, @current_user_id)
  { feature: feature, enabled: enabled, user_id: @current_user_id }.to_json
end

# Admin endpoint: Override feature flag for specific user
post '/api/v1/admin/features/override' do
  authenticate!

  # Admin check
  REDIS_POOL.with do |redis|
    is_admin = redis.sismember('admins', @current_user_id)
    halt 403, { error: 'forbidden' }.to_json unless is_admin
  end

  feature = json_body[:feature]
  target_user = json_body[:user_id]
  enabled = json_body[:enabled]

  halt 400, { error: 'missing_params' }.to_json unless feature && target_user && !enabled.nil?
  halt 404, { error: 'unknown_feature' }.to_json unless FeatureFlags::ROLLOUT_PERCENTAGES.key?(feature)

  REDIS_POOL.with do |redis|
    redis.hset("feature_overrides", "#{feature}:#{target_user}", enabled.to_s)
  end

  status 200
  { updated: true, feature: feature, user_id: target_user, enabled: enabled }.to_json
end

# Endpoint: Get user balance
get '/api/v1/balance' do
  authenticate!

  balance = REDIS_POOL.with { |r| r.get("balance:#{@current_user_id}") || '0' }
  { user_id: @current_user_id, balance: balance.to_i }.to_json
end
